items.quote: thy seed shall be as the dust of the earth
items.claim: Jacob's descendants will be as numerous as the dust of the earth

items.quote: thou shalt spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south
items.claim: Jacob's descendants will spread in all cardinal directions

items.quote: the land whereon thou liest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed
items.claim: God will give the land to Jacob and his descendants
